seed_choice: Project choice; the brief requires ten independent seeds.

ba.retention_policy: Every recruit is generated from the original site; the site keeps the best of itself and its recruits (strict improvement only).
ba.scouting_policy: Each iteration replaces the unselected sites with fresh uniformly random solutions.
ba.selection_note: Setting B from a pilot on seeds 100-104 (not the reported seeds 0-9), compared with 30/10/3/10/5 and 6/2/1/5/3 on all six instances and both moves, and on all eight continuous cases. Provisional until confirmed by the group.
